placements.why: Freya forcefully reinforces the sequential cutover strategy and soak duration by demonstrating that multi-site parallel cutovers are an arithmetic impossibility given supervisor staffing levels, while also highlighting the compounding benefit of cross-site team learning.
Xavier explicitly notes that the reporting replica isolation rule is predicated on having only a single cutover window active at any time, reinforcing the operational isolation boundary.
Xavier confirms that maintaining reference data authority with the vendor throughout the rollout assumes sequential one-at-a-time execution and would need rewriting under parallel cutovers.
